name: Chain
notes: Base for nearly every pattern; will dominate raw image counts

name: Slip stitch
notes: Low profile; can be visually subtle vs chain

name: Front post double crochet
notes: Visually similar to bpdc; watch precision once mixed in-frame

name: Shell stitch
notes: Multiple stitches worked into one base; label as one compound instance

name: V-stitch
notes: Two stitches with a chain gap worked into one base

name: Cluster stitch
notes: Multiple partial stitches joined at the top

name: Popcorn stitch
notes: Several dc worked into one stitch then closed

name: Bobble stitch
notes: Several partial dc worked into one stitch then closed
